@pivanov/utils/cache is now built from its own unsplit Bun build containing
nothing but the cache implementation, so the artifact a service worker imports

  cacheNames, cacheExists, cacheDelete, cacheClear

ReferenceError, when a runtime has no caches global.

feat(cache): add service-worker-safe @pivanov/utils/cache entry point (v1.0.1)

The Cache Storage helpers shipped only through @pivanov/utils/tools, whose
bundle carries React (useEventBus), the event bus and the DOM helpers. A
service worker that wanted storageGetItem had to pull all of it in.

@pivanov/utils/cache is now built from its own unsplit Bun build containing
nothing but the cache implementation, so the artifact a service worker imports
is a single self-contained file that cannot pick up a shared chunk. Verified:
the packed tarball imports in both ESM and CJS with react absent.

New raw response layer, for content JSON serialization would corrupt:

  cachePutResponse, cacheMatchResponse, cacheHasResponse,
  cacheDeleteResponse, cacheResponseKeys

Bodies, status codes and headers survive byte for byte. Put caches a clone, so
the caller's Response stays readable and can still be returned to the page.
Match, has and delete accept CacheQueryOptions, so ignoreSearch works across
cache-busting query strings.

New cache management helpers, for whole-cache work and revision cleanup:

  cacheNames, cacheExists, cacheDelete, cacheClear

Also adds isCacheStorageSupported() and a descriptive error, in place of a bare
ReferenceError, when a runtime has no caches global.

scripts/verify-dist.ts is a release-time regression over the real artifacts: it
checks every package.json#exports path exists, that the cache artifacts are
self-contained and free of react, react-dom, useEffect and event-bus
references, that both formats import and expose all 23 helpers, and that
@pivanov/utils/tools still re-exports them. It caught a genuine bug on the way
in: Bun dropped the isCacheStorageSupported declaration while keeping its
export binding, which is why that helper sits in its own module.

The implementation moved from src/tools/cache-api to src/cache. That is
internal: no published import path changed, and @pivanov/utils/tools and the
root export keep exposing every cache helper.
